questiondescription.text:
Sets: listing a described set

Grade 12 CBE Core and Essential 1.1 (a): List the elements of a set given by a description in words, and count them.

Core and Essential

This question is adapted from Chapter 2 (Sets), Exercise A, question 1 of School Mathematics Project, SMP Book 1 (Metric), Cambridge University Press, 1969: listing the members of sets described in words; every set is new and the count n(A) is added.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core and Essential Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).
